messages:
anya: quick heads-up — ran a cross-region infer bench (prefill + decode) comparing A100 vs H100 for Llama-2-7b-chat and Mistral-7b-v0. uploading a short summary + raw csv: https://internal.artifacts/bench/2087654321

benchbot: CI-run 2026-03-18T12:02: tests executed in us-west1 / eu-west1 / ap-southeast1. artifacts: /artifacts/2087654321 (results.csv, logs.tar.gz)

leo: great — what were the run params (batch, seq lengths, quant)?

anya: run params: batch=8, prefill_len=512, decode_len=256, kv_cache=true, continuous_batching=40ms, bf16 compute when supported. quant runs used q8_0 for cost numbers. kernels: H100 used flash_attn + triton GEMM; A100 used cuBLAS-tuned kernels with a small fallback path to slower kernels for some attention sizes.

matt: numbers please — tokens/sec, p50 latencies, and $/1M tokens estimate?

anya: pasted top-line table below (est costs combine instance hourly price + throughput). raw CSV has full region/GPU permutations.

```
Model            | GPU  | Region    | prefill_p50(ms) | dec_p50(ms/token) | tokens/sec | $/1M tokens (est)
Llama-2-7b-chat  | H100 | us-west1  | 260              | 6.8               | 1400       | $18.5
Llama-2-7b-chat  | A100 | us-west1  | 330              | 8.5               | 1120       | $15.2
Mistral-7b-v0    | H100 | eu-west1  | 240              | 5.9               | 1600       | $20.1
Mistral-7b-v0    | A100 | eu-west1  | 305              | 7.2               | 1280       | $16.4
```

anya: quick notes — H100 gives lower latency and higher tokens/sec, but instance hourly cost is higher (hence $/1M is close or slightly higher vs A100 for our public cloud SKU prices). the delta also varies by region due to sku pricing.

sophie: any quality regressions with q8_0?

anya: ran a 2k prompt eval set (mix of instruction + long-context QA). results: Mistral q8_0 avg metric delta ~ -0.6 (relative to fp16 baseline), Llama-2 q8_0 delta ~ -0.2. edge cases on code generation with Mistral show more dropped tokens, so leaning to keep fp16 for high-quality flows or gate q8 behind eval checks.

rav: for capacity planning — given an SLO p95 latency target of 300ms, what sizing do you recommend per region?

anya: rule-of-thumb from these runs: sustained per-GPU throughput at 95th latency ~1100 tokens/sec for A100 and ~1400 tokens/sec for H100 (prefill+decode mix like our bench). example: if you expect 100 qps with avg response length 200 tokens, that's 20k tokens/sec => ~18 A100 or ~15 H100. add 20% headroom + cross-zone redundancy => 22 A100 or 18 H100. numbers shift for heavier prefill patterns.

leo: any kernel or config flags we should flip for the production rollout?

anya: recommended flags: enable flash_attn on H100, prefer triton-gemm when kernel matches, use bf16 compute where model support exists, enable kv-prefetch for long contexts, and continuous batching window 30-50ms depending on latency SLO. also enable a fallback policy to pin to A100 variants if H100 capacity spikes cost too high.

matt: nice. do we have the raw CSV and run logs?

anya: uploaded: https://internal.artifacts/bench/2087654321/results.csv and logs: https://internal.artifacts/bench/2087654321/logs.tar.gz

benchbot: logs archived at /mnt/bench/logs/2087654321.tar.gz. run_id: rb-2087654321.

leo: thanks — will take these numbers into the capacity model and run a quick what-if on pricing tiers. :thumbsup:

anya: will follow up with a trimmed-to-SLA deck (one slide per region + ops checklist) tomorrow.

matt: awesome, ping me when the deck is up and we can sync with infra on rollout windows.
